note: Exports are factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with BOL numbers, HS codes and destinations (UAE, New Zealand, Côte d'Ivoire, Bangladesh) run from 2025-12-22 to 2026-02-07, i.e. the company is an active exporter. Declared HS set (220820/220830/220840/220850 — spirits) is broadly consistent with the observed trade, but the actual codes on record are 22086000 (vodka) and 22071090 (ethyl alcohol, undenatured <80% — a raw-material/industrial alcohol line, not a beverage spirit). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: the company stays in the base and the HS field should be corrected to the factual codes 220860 and 220710 alongside the declared 2208xx range. Note the company also appears as an importer (empty oak barrels from JOSE Y MIGUEL MARTIN S.L., Spain, HS 44160010, BOL 7493568, 2026-02-13), which is consistent with an own distillery/bottling operation rather than pure trading. Role: manufacturer_trader (own branded vodka 'North Pole' plus bulk ethyl alcohol sales). Caveat on the counter: ImportKey advertises 199 shipments but the free view exposes only 5 dated rows, so the 199 figure is a platform claim and is not independently verified; the 5 quoted rows are the verified evidence. The 'PVT LTD' slug variant (https://importkey.com/countries/india/khemani-distilleries-pvt-ltd) returned an empty record set — only the full legal-name slug carries data, so all name variants in the input refer to the same single entity.
